title: The horizon calculation is correct on test shapes
criterion: Agreement with exact formulas, correct compass direction, correct result after a rotation and after halving the step
summary: 14 of 14 automated tests passed. They cover 4 requirements.
details: The expected values come from exact formulas or from a second, independent 3D calculation in geometry.ts. We broke the compass convention on purpose one time, and the tests failed as they must.
